title: One Function, Any Comparable
goal: largest works for numbers and strings alike — the > in the body names its price.
hints: The only operation the body performs on T is `>`. Which trait provides comparison operators?
Display is for printing — main prints, but the FUNCTION never does.
explanation: Monomorphized generics ask for capabilities via bounds, and the body defines the ask: `item > max` desugars to PartialOrd::gt, so T: PartialOrd is necessary and sufficient — the compiler stamps out an i32 version and a &str version at zero runtime cost. Display fails because comparison isn't printing (even though main happens to print the results — bounds serve the body, not the caller). This is THE generics reflex: capabilities in, one implementation out.
